pages.title: About
pages.seoDescription: Meet Timo, the frontend developer who runs Hello World Cards, and Sam, the Wooper fan who comes along to events.

blocks.title: Hello from Hello World Cards
blocks.description: I'm Timo, and this little shop is what my Pokémon hobby turned into. You'll find cards online, the events I'm heading to, and a stall when Sam and I are out.
blocks.figcaption: This is us in our natural habitat.

blocks.title: A hobby that turned into a little shop
blocks.description: I never quite grew out of Pokémon, and I write software for a living, which is why the shop is called Hello World Cards. I list every card here, on Marktplaats and on Vinted, and put the events I'm heading to on the agenda. My partner Sam shares the hobby and comes along to those events.
blocks.peopleCaption: Two nerds who never quite outgrew Pokémon.

people.name: Timo
people.description: Frontend developer who has been after Gengar and Ralts for years. Ghosts, psychics, and a few odd frogs are a forever chase. Mewtwo still stops a scroll, Shroomish is an easy yes, and Flygon and Politoed are the ones that make an event stall last a little longer than it should. A Gengar or Ralts full art almost never gets walked past at a table. Timo runs the shop, from the listings to the site itself.

people.name: Sam
people.description: Backend developer, and a die-hard Wooper and Quagsire collector. The muddy, dopey Water-types are a forever chase. Psyduck and Slowpoke live in the same pile, Snorlax too: same sleepy energy as Sam. Mew shows up whenever the art is too pretty to skip, and cute or pretty full arts almost never get walked past at a table. Sam is Timo's partner, and comes along to events mostly to find the next Wooper.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.seoDescription: How Hello World Cards uses Google Tag Manager and Microsoft Clarity, and what happens when you send Timo a message.

blocks.heading: h1
blocks.title: Privacy statement
blocks.description: Hello World Cards is a small Pokémon card shop run by Timo. This page says what happens when you visit the site or send me a message, including through the contact form.

sections.title: Who I am
sections.body: I'm Timo, and I run Hello World Cards. I list Pokémon cards here, on Marktplaats and on Vinted, and put the events I go to on the agenda. You can reach me at [helloworldcards@outlook.com](mailto:helloworldcards@outlook.com).

sections.title: Messages you send me
sections.body: If you use the contact form or email me, I receive your name, email address, and message so I can reply. I do not sell that information or use it for ads. If you want a message deleted, email me and I will remove it.

sections.title: Google Tag Manager
sections.body: I use Google Tag Manager to add measurement tools to the site. It may set cookies and load other Google tags. See [Google's privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

sections.title: Microsoft Clarity
sections.body: I use Microsoft Clarity to see how people move around the shop. Clarity uses cookies. See [Microsoft's privacy statement](https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement) and [Clarity's terms](https://clarity.microsoft.com/terms).

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: Google Tag Manager and Microsoft Clarity may store cookies in your browser. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. The shop will still work.

faqs.question: What is Hello World Cards?
faqs.answer: A small Pokémon card shop. I'm Timo, and I list every card here, on Marktplaats and on Vinted: the same stock in all three places. There is no walk-in storefront.

faqs.question: Who runs Hello World Cards?
faqs.answer: I do. I'm Timo, a frontend developer who collects Pokémon and chases Gengar and Ralts. My partner Sam shares the hobby, collects Wooper and Quagsire, and comes along to events.

faqs.question: Why is it called Hello World Cards?
faqs.answer: Because I write software for a living. Hello World is the first thing you print when you learn to code, so it felt like the right name for a shop that is still a hobby at heart.

faqs.question: Do you have a physical shop?
faqs.answer: No walk-in storefront. I sell cards here, on Marktplaats and on Vinted, and in person when I have a stall at a Pokémon event in the Netherlands or Belgium.

faqs.question: What do you sell?
faqs.answer: Graded Pokémon cards. Every card is listed here, on Marktplaats and on Vinted, and I bring them along when I have a stall at an event.

faqs.question: How do I buy a card?
faqs.answer: Browse the shop on this site. If a card has a View on Marktplaats button, that is the listing and you buy it there. Every card is on Vinted too, if you would rather buy there. If the button says it is not yet available to buy, the card is on the site but not for sale yet. Email and the contact form are for questions, not for buying.

faqs.question: What does it mean when a card says Sold?
faqs.answer: The card has found a buyer and is on its way to its new owner, so it can no longer be bought. It stays on the site for a little while before it leaves the shop.

faqs.question: How can I get in touch?
faqs.answer: Use the form on this page, email me, or find me on Instagram @helloworldcards or my Marktplaats page. Email is the one that always works, for a card, an event, or anything else.

faqs.question: Where can I meet you in person?
faqs.answer: At a Pokémon event, when I have a stall. Those dates go on the agenda. I bring cards from the shop, and Sam comes along too.
